newsitem.title: UK: UK NATURAL GAS STEADY AS MARKET CONSOLIDATES.
newsitem.headline: UK NATURAL GAS STEADY AS MARKET CONSOLIDATES.

text.p: U.K. natural gas spot prices were little moved on Monday, consolidating losses made on Friday, traders said.
"There's no real changes today, we're just in line with the close on Friday," said one trader.
The first quarter 1998, was actively traded at 17.00 pence a therm, in the middle of Friday's trading range.
The second quarter, which was untraded on Friday, changed hands at 11.45 pence, up from last traded levels.
At the front end of the forward curve, September eased slightly to trade at 9.2 pence, while October held steady, trading at 10.95 and 10.925 pence a therm.
"It's quiet relaxed, there's no great interest on either side today," said one trader.
A similar story was seen on the IPE screen contract, which drifted in mixed directions in lacklustre trade. A total of 145 lots changed hands.
